2. For the reasons mentioned therein, the application seeking condonation of delay of 30 days in re-filing the petition is allowed.

3. Petitioners seek quashing of FIR No.823/2020 of PS Harsh Vihar for offence under Section 406/498A/509/323/506/34 IPC on the ground that complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised all disputes with the petitioners.
4. Since none of the private parties or their counsel are present, relist on 11.12.2025.
